content: NestJS JWT refresh best practice: short-lived access token, longer-lived refresh token; store only a hash of the refresh token server-side, never the raw token. Rotate on every use (issue new access+refresh, invalidate old hash) to limit stolen-token windows. Recommended incremental path: ship plain rotation first, then add reuse detection via a token-family id — if a rotated-out token is presented again, revoke the whole family (forces re-login), which is what backs a real 'log out everywhere'. Logout must delete/invalidate the stored hash immediately.
